readme:
# Douyin Similar Daren Accounts API

Look up related Douyin daren comparable to a target account using the `user_id` parameter.

## Use cases

- Discover alternative Douyin daren within a specific content niche.
- Identify comparable influencer accounts for campaign benchmarking.
- Expand talent research rosters based on existing high-performing profiles.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/douyin/index/daren-similar-users" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"user_id": "<user_id>"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | string | Yes | Douyin uid (numeric, e.g. "3100268042915212") |

## Notes

- Provide a numeric Douyin user ID for the `user_id` parameter.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [Douyin Index Area List](/apis/douyin/index/all-area): Returns the complete list of supported geographic areas available for Douyin Index queries.
- [Douyin Index Valid Dates](/apis/douyin/index/all-valid-date): Returns the latest valid dates available for each data type in Douyin Index.
- [Douyin Brand Popularity Cycles](/apis/douyin/index/brand-cycles): Returns periodic brand popularity and cycle analysis data across platforms for a specified brand name and date range.
